method: Actual GLTFLoader/AnimationMixer bones and fully skinned shoe vertices; 61 samples per clip plus exact 1.0 second contact. Every non-body root joint compares its rest attachment point transformed by both adjacent bones.
limitations: Checks anatomical centre attachment and sole surfaces. Artistic self-occlusion and cloth compression are also judged in the reimported views/reel; no physical Safari or frame-time claim.
